messages.text:
I've made a new proposal for the Merino wool beanie. The refund is 24.90 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount). Your earlier request lapsed before it was paid, so a new proposal was needed (refund-policy/v2/validity). To confirm, press the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't confirm anything. After you confirm, a staff member still has to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

I can't get you a refund for the leather winter gloves before they're back. The shop refunds only units it has received back, according to its return records (refund-policy/v2/return). A staff member can't approve a refund the policy doesn't allow (refund-policy/v2/exceptions). The records show the gloves haven't arrived yet. Once they arrive, you can ask for a refund. Your order's refund deadline is 2026-12-02 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window), so please send them back in time for that request.
